name: Engineering Craft Pack
description: Cross-cutting engineering skills for modern software teams: observability, database design, accessibility, TypeScript discipline, AI feature development, and monorepo tooling.
useCases: Add structured logging, metrics, and traces to a service that lacks observability.
Design or review a database schema change and its migration path.
Tighten TypeScript typing, accessibility, or monorepo hygiene across an existing codebase.
examplePrompts: Review this schema migration for safety, then add the observability we would need to catch a bad rollout.
Audit this package for TypeScript strictness and accessibility issues and fix the highest-impact ones.
